KRR training alignment indicators are all constant zero; stress cases are deliberately off that training support.

recommendations.finding: Ordinary-test errors are substantially lower than FLOP-only and 3-parameter roofline comparators in all four tested contexts.
recommendations.bound: This is conditional A100/torch/cuBLAS/shape/cache/precision evidence. It is not a universal accuracy guarantee or serving/end-to-end validation.

recommendations.finding: All four selected models underpredict the narrow N=128,K=896 family; the multiplicative correction cap is directly active.
recommendations.evidence: The selected 2-parameter baseline has zero constant overhead. Raw learned corrections of about x10-x19 are clipped to x4 for the worst tiny cases.
recommendations.next: In a future model revision, assess an additive-overhead baseline or training-CV-calibrated correction bounds using training data only. Do not remove the cap and claim improved held-out performance on this now-inspected test set without a fresh final test.

recommendations.finding: Warm-reuse challenge errors are about 29% weighted mean; simple FLOP-only is better on that particular held-out scope.
recommendations.evidence: Error concentrates in unseen NK families 1536x8960,8960x1536,9728x896. Their worst rows are not the six flagged-quality rows.
recommendations.next: Treat this as a generalization limitation. Inspect shape/cache/regime structure on training data; preserve the current CV choice and report baseline comparisons.

recommendations.finding: Artificial irregular stress is systematically underpredicted, especially M>=16.
recommendations.evidence: All four training alignment indicators are constant zero, while stress uses N+1,K+1. Stress corrections are not clipped, so the observed poor stress predictions cannot be fixed solely by relaxing the correction cap.
recommendations.next: Add representative irregular shapes to a future training/development workload and reserve new unexposed stress families for evaluation. Distinguish this data-coverage change from a rerun of the same experiment.

recommendations.finding: Six primary quality flags remain included; ordinary-test evaluation has zero directly flagged rows.
recommendations.bound: Three flagged rows are in training and can still influence fitted models. Quality-passing alone does not prove every latency is free of systematic effects.

recommendations.finding: Two ordinary-test vocabulary shapes are M extrapolation within already-seen NK families.
recommendations.bound: Only two distinct shapes, warm-reuse only, combined approximately0.053% test weight. Their low errors do not establish broad extrapolation capability.

recommendations.finding: Recorded pairwise ordering is high on ordinary tests.
recommendations.bound: It compares latency order across different shapes, excludes approximately1%-close actual-time pairs, and is not kernel-selection or scheduler-decision accuracy.
CV fold dispersion is tuning variability, not a confidence or prediction interval for a future shape.
